entities.name: Same-Sex Marriage Legalization
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The Netherlands became the first country to legalize same-sex marriage in 2001. By 2024, 35 countries recognize it — including the US (Obergefell v. Hodges, 2015), all of Western Europe, Taiwan, and parts of Latin America. The movement went from criminal to legal in one generation.
